outline.text: How to check grammar in Microsoft Word
Create a new document or open an existing file in Word for the web.
Enter text or copy and paste text into the document to review grammar.
Check for grammar issues highlighted directly in the document as writing progresses.
Review each suggestion and select a recommended correction to apply changes.
Save the updated file online to OneDrive, send with a shareable link or export as a PDF.
